name: ShopEcho
tagline: Helps small Shopify brands define their identity, check trends against it and draft campaigns.

awards: TwelveLabs: Build The Future of Video Understanding with TwelveLabs

problem: Small brands struggle to reach an audience before they understand their own identity.
solution: Reads store data, keeps a brand manifesto up to date through an agent, analyses uploaded videos with video understanding against that manifesto, and drafts content ideas and email campaigns.
demo_moment: Team-described: upload a trend video and see whether it fits your brand, then get a draft campaign.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “TwelveLabs: Build The Future of Video Understanding with TwelveLabs” among 160 submissions.
Checks trends against a written brand identity before acting.

lessons: A brand 'manifesto' gives the AI a reference to judge against.
